title_zh: 乡村振兴：年轻人回乡创业
title_en: Rural Revitalization: Young People Go Home to Start Businesses
note_en: Notice 正是…才… in 像小张这样的创业者，正是在这样的政策背景下，才申请到了低息贷款 "it was precisely against this policy backdrop that entrepreneurs like Xiao Zhang were able to get low-interest loans." English uses an "it was… that…" cleft sentence for this emphasis; Chinese marks the key condition with 正是 ("precisely") and puts 才 ("only then") before the verb.
